note: Solomon Islands: musicians and bands coming to perform for commercial purposes (concerts, gigs, promotional events) take the Immigration Division's Entertainer Visa, US$400, a stay of 60 days, valid two years with multiple entries, on a letter from a sponsor in the islands; longer employment takes the employment visa on a work permit. No days without a visa.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division, Entertainer Visa – Musician (Commercial)
sources.said: This visa is for musicians or bands visiting the Solomon Islands to perform for commercial purposes such as concerts, gigs, or promotional events. ... Visa fee: $400 USD ... Permitted stay: 60 days
